items.t: High-voltage battery loses voltage, causing reduced power or no propulsion
items.job: Replace battery energy control module or high-voltage battery section
items.note: Often free under GM programs or the 8-year/100,000-mile EV battery warranty. Full pack replacement out of warranty can cost much more.

items.t: "Propulsion Power is Reduced" from battery cell imbalance
items.job: Replace high-voltage battery section and rebalance pack
items.note: Often covered by the battery warranty or GM programs. A full used or rebuilt pack out of warranty can cost more.

items.t: Software update may stop battery cell balancing (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: "Shift to Park" message won't let the car turn off
items.job: Repair or replace shifter park switch per GM bulletin 19-NA-206
items.note: Cheaper parts-only repairs exist; a full shifter replacement costs more.

items.t: Shifter hard to move into or out of Park
items.job: Adjust shift cable or replace shifter assembly
items.note: May be a simple adjustment; a new shifter costs more.

items.t: 12-volt battery drains and car won't power on
items.note: If the accessory power module has failed, the cost is much higher.

items.t: Gas engine may auto-start in a closed garage (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Whining noise from the drive unit
items.job: Repair drive unit (bearings) or replace with reman unit
items.note: CarComplaints shows an average repair cost of about $1,200.

items.t: Power steering cuts out while driving
items.note: CarComplaints shows an average of about $3,000.

items.t: Infotainment screen freezes or fails
items.job: Update software or replace radio / display unit
items.note: CarComplaints shows an average of about $1,200.

items.t: Loss of propulsion or no-start from loose high-voltage connection
items.job: Inspect and secure high-voltage fuse and interlock connector
items.note: May be covered by a GM customer satisfaction program.

items.t: Check engine light and lost regen when pressing both pedals
items.job: Clear codes and reprogram control module

items.t: Front brakes may not release during ABS or traction control (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Inner tie rod may separate (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Driver airbag may inflate improperly (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may rupture (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Rear brake calipers may reduce braking (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Rear seatbelt may not lock for child seats (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Windshield washer pump stops working
Power window stops or falls into the door
items.job: Replace window regulator (and motor if needed)
items.note: RepairPal shows about $360 to $480 for regulator and motor replacement.
